summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing a $1.2M Stage 2 CDMO contract for developing a rare fragrance using its Botanical Synthesis platform. The contract follows a successful Stage 1 and grants BioHarvest 20% ownership of developed compositions plus future royalties. No price per share, premium, or M&A terms are involved. This is a routine business development contract, not a special situation.
